description:
Update a Conduct space's SwappableIntelligence harness configuration.

Each parameter targets a specific key in the stored configuration. Only provided
(non-None) parameters are written; everything else in the existing config is preserved.
Use get_conduct_config first to inspect the current state.

agent_md_instructions.description: Admin AGENT.md content injected into the workspace (setup.agentMdInstructions).

claude_autocompact_pct.description: Context autocompact threshold percentage for claude_code (10–95).

claude_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the claude_code strategy.

claude_max_context_tokens.description: Maximum context window tokens for claude_code (50 000–500 000).

claude_model.description: Claude model ID for the claude_code/claude_sandbox strategy.

claude_permission_mode.description: Tool permission mode for the claude_code strategy. 'bypassPermissions' skips all confirmation prompts.

codex_model.description: Model ID for the codex strategy.

codex_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level for the codex strategy.

custom_instructions.description: Instructions appended to the agent system prompt (setup.customInstructions).

enable_code_execution.description: Enable bash/write/read tools in the agent (setup.enableCodeExecution).

max_turns.description: Maximum agent turns (1–1000). Applied to the active strategy block (claude.maxTurns, piAgent.maxTurns, or codex.maxTurns).

mcp_integration_mode.description: How MCP servers are exposed to the agent: as 'tools' or 'skills' (setup.mcpIntegrationMode).

pi_agent_model_name.description: Model ID for the pi_agent strategy.

pi_agent_thinking_level.description: Thinking depth for the pi_agent strategy.

progress_update_abort_s.description: Abort the agent after this many seconds without a progress update. Set to null/None to disable (setup.progressUpdateAbortS).

show_thinking_in_chat.description: Show agent thinking steps in the chat UI (setup.showThinkingInChat).

show_tool_calls_in_chat.description: Show tool calls in the chat UI (setup.showToolCallsInChat).

space_id.description: ID of the Conduct space to update.

strategy.description: Agent execution strategy. 'claude_code' is the standard Claude Code runner. 'pi_agent' uses a Pi-model runner. 'codex' uses an OpenAI Codex runner.

system_prompt_override.description: When non-empty, fully replaces the agent system prompt (setup.systemPromptOverride).

name: update_conduct_config
title: Update Conduct Config

description: Merge config_patch into a module's configuration dict. Existing unpatched keys are kept.

config_patch.description: Keys to merge into the module's configuration dict. Existing keys not in the patch are preserved. For Conduct spaces, prefer update_conduct_config instead.

module_id.description: ID of the module to update.

name: update_module_config
title: Update Module Config

description: Update space metadata. Only the fields you provide are changed.

alert.description: Alert text shown to users of the space.

explanation.description: Description / system-prompt text for the space.

is_pinned.description: Pin the space to the top of listings.

name.description: New display name for the space.

settings.description: Arbitrary settings dict merged at space level.

space_id.description: ID of the space to update.

name: update_space
title: Update Space
